events.title: 영국 포크스턴에서 태어나다
events.description_en: He was born in Folkestone, Kent, England.

events.title: 케임브리지에서 의학을 공부하다
events.description: 케임브리지대 곤빌 앤드 키즈 칼리지에서 인문학과 의학을 공부했다.
events.description_en: He studied the arts and medicine at Gonville and Caius College, Cambridge.

events.title: 파도바에서 해부학을 배워 박사가 되다
events.title_en: He studied anatomy at Padua and earned his doctorate
events.description: 유럽 최고로 꼽히던 파도바대 의학교에 들어가 해부학자 파브리키우스에게 배웠다. 1602년 박사학위를 받았다.
events.description_en: He entered the medical school at Padua, then reckoned the best in Europe, and studied under the anatomist Fabricius. He earned his doctorate in 1602.

events.title: 성 바르톨로메오 병원 의사가 되다
events.title_en: He became a physician at St Bartholomew's Hospital
events.description: 런던 성 바르톨로메오 병원의 보조 의사로 임명되며 평생 이어질 인연을 시작했다.
events.description_en: He was appointed assistant physician at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London, beginning a lifelong association with the institution.

events.title: 왕립내과의사회 해부학·외과학 교수가 되다
events.title_en: He became professor of anatomy and surgery at the College of Physicians
events.description: 왕립내과의사회에서 해부학과 외과학을 가르치는 교수로 임명됐다.
events.description_en: He was appointed professor of anatomy and surgery at the Royal College of Physicians.

events.title: 제임스 1세의 시의가 되다
events.title_en: He became physician to King James I
events.description_en: He was appointed physician extraordinary to King James I.

events.title: 심장과 혈액의 운동을 밝힌 책을 내다
events.title_en: He published his book on the motion of the heart and blood
events.description: 심장이 펌프처럼 뛰어 피를 온몸에 순환시킨다는 사실을 실험으로 증명한 책을 냈다. 의학사에서 혈액순환론을 처음 세운 저작이다.
events.description_en: He published a book proving through experiment that the heart works like a pump, driving blood in a circuit through the body. It was the first work to establish the theory of blood circulation.

events.title: 찰스 1세의 시의가 되다
events.title_en: He became physician to King Charles I
events.description: 제임스 1세에 이어 찰스 1세의 정식 시의로 임명됐다.
events.description_en: Following James I, he was appointed physician in ordinary to King Charles I.

events.title: 에지힐 전투에서 왕자들을 지키다
events.title_en: He protected the royal princes at the Battle of Edgehill
events.description: 영국 내전의 첫 큰 전투인 에지힐 전투에 왕을 수행해 있었다. 어린 왕자들을 울타리 뒤에 숨겨 지켰다.
events.description_en: He accompanied the king to the Battle of Edgehill, the first major clash of the English Civil War, and kept the young princes safe behind a hedge.

events.title: 옥스퍼드 머튼 칼리지 학장이 되다
events.title_en: He became Warden of Merton College, Oxford
events.description: 왕을 따라 옥스퍼드로 옮겨 머튼 칼리지 학장으로 선출됐다. 이듬해 도시가 의회군에 항복하자 런던으로 돌아왔다.
events.description_en: He followed the king to Oxford and was elected Warden of Merton College. When the city surrendered to Parliamentary forces the following year, he returned to London.

events.title: 동물의 발생에 관한 책을 내다
events.title_en: He published his book on the generation of animals
events.description: 수정과 발생 과정을 다룬 책을 냈다. 뒷날 발생학의 토대가 되었다.
events.description_en: He published a book on conception and embryonic development, later becoming a foundation of embryology.

events.title: 런던 근교에서 죽다
events.description: 런던 근교 로햄프턴에서 세상을 떠났다. 여든을 앞둔 나이였다.
events.description_en: He died at Roehampton, near London, just short of eighty.
